scripts.reset: bash control-plane/scripts/local-down.sh && docker compose -f control-plane/docker-compose.yml --profile github-app down -v && (docker volume rm devbox-repos || true) && (docker volume ls -q --filter label=devbox.task-volume | xargs -r docker volume rm)
scripts.k8s:install: bun run setup && bun control-plane/scripts/k8s.ts install
scripts.k8s:kind: bun run setup && bun control-plane/scripts/k8s.ts kind
scripts.linear:setup: bun run setup && bun control-plane/scripts/linear.ts setup
scripts.github:setup: bun run setup && bun control-plane/scripts/github.ts setup
scripts.test: cd harness && make test && cd ../control-plane && bun test && cd ../cli && bun test && cd .. && bun run test:chart
